# Command line (`delegation-core`)

**50 commands.** Every command that touches the index hands the work to the
running daemon instead of opening a second copy of it.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`aferir-busca`](#delegation-core-aferir-busca) | Mede a qualidade da busca e compara com a ultima medicao |
| [`approvals`](#delegation-core-approvals) | Human approvals requested by tool policies |
| [`backup`](#delegation-core-backup) | Rotating local backup of config and state |
| [`clients`](#delegation-core-clients) | Point MCP clients at the HTTP daemon (migrates from stdio) |
| [`compress`](#delegation-core-compress) | Extract key facts/decisions/action items from text via llama.cpp |
| [`config`](#delegation-core-config) | Config revisions: history and revert |
| [`dashboard-api`](#delegation-core-dashboard-api) | Run the local JSON API used by the Tauri dashboard (standalone/debug) |
| [`doctor`](#delegation-core-doctor) | Diagnose installation drift and vault hygiene problems |
| [`embed-llama`](#delegation-core-embed-llama) | Run the BGE search model on llama.cpp instead of torch (the Mac setup) |
| [`embed-model`](#delegation-core-embed-model) | List calibrated embedding models, or switch to one |
| [`errors-catalog`](#delegation-core-errors-catalog) | Every user-visible MCP error, ranked by harm (CSV) |
| [`eval-search`](#delegation-core-eval-search) | Measure search on known-answer questions: hits, MRR, nDCG, latency |
| [`export`](#delegation-core-export) | Export config (no secrets) and state to a .zip |
| [`feedback`](#delegation-core-feedback) | Search feedback votes: report, export to eval questions |
| [`filters`](#delegation-core-filters) | Output filters: list, verify (RTK inline tests), hook (Claude Code PreToolUse) |
| [`graph`](#delegation-core-graph) | Code-graph pipeline: build/list/report/affected/hook (needs [graph] extra) |
| [`hook`](#delegation-core-hook) | Agent hook: read the host's PreToolUse payload on stdin, answer in its format |
| [`import`](#delegation-core-import) | Import an export .zip (dry run unless --apply) |
| [`index-compare`](#delegation-core-index-compare) | Run the same queries on the Chroma and SQLite indexes |
| [`index-migrate`](#delegation-core-index-migrate) | Migrate the ChromaDB index to the SQLite index, verified, without touching the old one |
| [`ingest`](#delegation-core-ingest) | Index files from an external folder without moving them |
| [`ingest-registry`](#delegation-core-ingest-registry) | Rebuild ingested_sources.json from the rows of an index |
| [`kompress`](#delegation-core-kompress) | Headroom's Kompress text compressor (ML model): setup or status |
| [`maintain`](#delegation-core-maintain) | Run inbox maintenance once and exit |
| [`mcp-stdio`](#delegation-core-mcp-stdio) | Serve MCP on stdio, forwarding to the daemon (how Claude Desktop connects) |
| [`note`](#delegation-core-note) | Direct vault note access: write/read/update/list/find-similar |
| [`ocr-setup`](#delegation-core-ocr-setup) | Download OCR language data so images become searchable |
| [`policy`](#delegation-core-policy) | Per-client tool policies: allow/block/require_approval/rate_limit |
| [`post-install`](#delegation-core-post-install) | Finish an install: docs, hooks, skills, dashboard, service, clients |
| [`process`](#delegation-core-process) | Cross-session process tracking: create/list/update/get |
| [`proposals`](#delegation-core-proposals) | Note edits proposed by agents: list/show/apply/reject |
| [`proxy`](#delegation-core-proxy) | API proxy that compresses tool outputs before they reach the model |
| [`recall`](#delegation-core-recall) | Original output saved when a filter cut it |
| [`recover-index`](#delegation-core-recover-index) | Move a damaged index aside; the daemon rebuilds it on its next start |
| [`reindex`](#delegation-core-reindex) | Rebuild the search index from vault folders |
| [`relink`](#delegation-core-relink) | Add wikilinks to notes in a vault subfolder |
| [`repair-empty-source`](#delegation-core-repair-empty-source) | Find notes synthesised from files that had no extractable text |
| [`rewrite`](#delegation-core-rewrite) | Rewrite a shell command to run through the output filters (exit 3) or not (exit 1) |
| [`run`](#delegation-core-run) | Start the MCP server (used by Claude Desktop) |
| [`search`](#delegation-core-search) | Query the vault (BGE similarity search, no LLM required) |
| [`service`](#delegation-core-service) | Install/remove/stop/start the daemon as a per-user background service |
| [`session`](#delegation-core-session) | Configure raw Claude Code and Codex transcript capture |
| [`setup`](#delegation-core-setup) | Interactive setup wizard (run once per machine) |
| [`shell`](#delegation-core-shell) | Run a shell command and show its output through the RTK filters |
| [`status`](#delegation-core-status) | Check vault, model, binary, llama.cpp, and feature config |
| [`test-drive`](#delegation-core-test-drive) | Throwaway daemon with its own HOME, vault and port |
| [`token`](#delegation-core-token) | Per-client tokens: read-only or read-write |
| [`uninstall`](#delegation-core-uninstall) | Remove the installation (keeps your vault and downloaded models) |
| [`update`](#delegation-core-update) | Update the installed package from its source, stopping the daemon first |
| [`update-finish`](#delegation-core-update-finish) | Internal: second half of `update`, run by it in the newly installed code |

## `delegation-core aferir-busca`

Mede a qualidade da busca e compara com a ultima medicao

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--amostras` | Quantas consultas (mais amostras, margem menor)Default: `50`. |
| `--semente` | Fixa o sorteio para duas corridas serem comparaveis |
| `--gravar` | Grava esta medicao como a nova referencia |

## `delegation-core approvals`

Human approvals requested by tool policies


### `delegation-core approvals list`

list approval requests

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--status` | which requests to list (one of: `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `used`, `expired`, `all`)Default: `"pending"`. |

### `delegation-core approvals approve`

approve a pending request

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | request id |
| `--reason` | why, recorded with the decision |

### `delegation-core approvals deny`

deny a pending request

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | request id |
| `--reason` | why, recorded with the decision |

### `delegation-core approvals prune`

delete decided requests older than --days

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--days` | age in daysDefault: `30`. |

## `delegation-core backup`

Rotating local backup of config and state

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--keep` | backups to keepDefault: `10`. |
| `--status` | show the existing backups instead of making one |

## `delegation-core clients`

Point MCP clients at the HTTP daemon (migrates from stdio)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--claude-code` | Rewrite delegation-core's entry in ~/.claude.json |
| `--claude-desktop` | Point Claude Desktop (claude_desktop_config.json) at the daemon |
| `--antigravity` | Point Antigravity / the Gemini CLI (agy) at the daemon |
| `--codex` | Append delegation-core's table to ~/.codex/config.toml |
| `--cursor` | Write ~/.cursor/mcp.json |
| `--opencode` | Write ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json |
| `--show` | Print URL and token without writing anything |

## `delegation-core compress`

Extract key facts/decisions/action items from text via llama.cpp

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `source` | Short label for what this text is (e.g. a filename or 'email thread') |
| `--file` | Read content from this file instead of stdin |

## `delegation-core config`

Config revisions: history and revert


### `delegation-core config history`

list saved revisions

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--limit` | revisions to listDefault: `10`. |

### `delegation-core config revert`

revert to revision N (1 = the one before the current config)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `revision` | revision number (1 = the one before the current config) |

## `delegation-core dashboard-api`

Run the local JSON API used by the Tauri dashboard (standalone/debug)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--port` | Port to bind (0 = pick a free one) |
| `--host` | address to listen onDefault: `"127.0.0.1"`. |

## `delegation-core doctor`

Diagnose installation drift and vault hygiene problems

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--clean-orphans` | Remove orphan ChromaDB segment directories on disk (index backups from update/index-migrate are kept) |
| `--include-backups` | With --clean-orphans: also remove the .chroma*-backup-* directories, the way back to the previous index |
| `--rebuild-fts` | Rebuild SQLite full-text search index if corrupted |

## `delegation-core embed-llama`

Run the BGE search model on llama.cpp instead of torch (the Mac setup)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `action` | setup: find llama-server, download the GGUF, switch the backend on (one of: `setup`, `status`) |
| `--no-download` | do not download anything; use what is already on disk |

## `delegation-core embed-model`

List calibrated embedding models, or switch to one

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `model` | Model to switch to; omit to list what is available |
| `--reindex` | Reindex the vault into the new model's collection |

## `delegation-core errors-catalog`

Every user-visible MCP error, ranked by harm (CSV)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--write` | rewrite docs/erros-visiveis.csv in the source tree |

## `delegation-core eval-search`

Measure search on known-answer questions: hits, MRR, nDCG, latency

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `arquivo` | questions JSON (default ~/.delegation_core/avaliacao/consultas.json) |
| `--scope` | comma-separated scopesDefault: `"notes,all"`. |
| `-k` | results per question that count as a hitDefault: `5`. |
| `--json` | print JSON |
| `--gate` | exit 1 when a scope is below the targets |
| `--min-mrr` | MRR target for --gateDefault: `0.95`. |
| `--min-ndcg` | nDCG target for --gateDefault: `0.9`. |

## `delegation-core export`

Export config (no secrets) and state to a .zip

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `path` | where to write the .zip |
| `--with-vault` | also pack the vault's markdown |

## `delegation-core feedback`

Search feedback votes: report, export to eval questions


### `delegation-core feedback report`

summary of votes: worst sources and queries with no useful result

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--days` | period in daysDefault: `30`. |

### `delegation-core feedback export`

write useful votes as eval-search questions

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `out` | questions file to write |
| `--days` | only votes from the last N days (0 = all) |
| `--force` | overwrite an existing file |

## `delegation-core filters`

Output filters: list, verify (RTK inline tests), hook (Claude Code PreToolUse)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `acao` | list the filters, verify them against RTK's inline tests, or answer as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook (one of: `list`, `verify`, `hook`) |

## `delegation-core graph`

Code-graph pipeline: build/list/report/affected/hook (needs [graph] extra)


### `delegation-core graph build`

Build a code graph for a local directory

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--local` | Do the work in this process instead of handing it to the running daemon |
| `path` | directory to graph |
| `--name` | Graph name (default: directory basename) |
| `--force` | Rebuild even if already built |

### `delegation-core graph preview`

Show what a build would cover, without building or writing anything

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `path` | directory to preview |
| `--name` | Graph name (default: directory basename) |

### `delegation-core graph extract-sources`

Reconstruct original sources from .js.map sidecars, then graph those

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `path` | directory with the .js.map files |
| `out_dir` | Destination directory (must be empty or absent) |

### `delegation-core graph list`

List previously built graphs


### `delegation-core graph report`

Print a graph's full GRAPH_REPORT.md

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `name` | graph name (see: delegation-core graph list) |

### `delegation-core graph affected`

Blast-radius query: what's affected if X changes

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `name` | Graph name (see: delegation-core graph list) |
| `query` | A file path or symbol label, e.g. auth.py or AuthService.login |
| `--depth` | how many hops to followDefault: `2`. |

### `delegation-core graph hook`

Git post-commit hook: auto-rebuild a graph after every commit


#### `delegation-core graph hook install`

Install the post-commit hook

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `path` | Path inside the git repo (default: cwd) |
| `--name` | Graph name (default: repo directory basename) |

#### `delegation-core graph hook uninstall`

Remove the post-commit hook

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `path` | repository (default: the current directory) |

#### `delegation-core graph hook status`

Check whether the hook is installed

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `path` | repository (default: the current directory) |

## `delegation-core hook`

Agent hook: read the host's PreToolUse payload on stdin, answer in its format

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `host` | agent whose hook payload format is used (one of: `antigravity`, `claude`, `codex`, `copilot-cli`, `copilot-ide`, `cursor`, `droid`, `gemini`, `trae`, `vibe`, `vscode`) |

## `delegation-core import`

Import an export .zip (dry run unless --apply)

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `path` | the .zip to import |
| `--map` | OLD=NEW path prefix rewrite, repeatable |
| `--vault` | where to unpack vault notes, if the package has them |
| `--apply` | write the changes (without it, only report what would change) |

## `delegation-core index-compare`

Run the same queries on the Chroma and SQLite indexes

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from` | Chroma index directory (default: the configured one) |
| `--amostra` | queries run on both indexesDefault: `100`. |

## `delegation-core index-migrate`

Migrate the ChromaDB index to the SQLite index, verified, without touching the old one

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from` | Chroma index directory (default: the configured one) |
| `--amostra` | queries used to compare neighboursDefault: `50`. |
| `--ativar` | set index_backend=sqlite after a verified migration |
| `--force` | migrate even with the daemon listening (unsafe) |

## `delegation-core ingest`

Index files from an external folder without moving them

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `path` | Absolute path to a file or directory to index |
| `--configured` | Run one configured source by name, or all enabled sources when NAME is omitted |
| `--no-recursive` | Only index top-level files |
| `--force` | Re-index even if file mtime and size are unchanged |
| `--exclude` | Comma-separated glob patterns to exclude (e.g. Logs,*.tmp) |
| `--timeout` | Maximum seconds to wait for daemon job to complete (default 3600s, 0 for unlimited) |
| `--local` | Do the work in this process instead of handing it to the running daemon |

## `delegation-core ingest-registry`

Rebuild ingested_sources.json from the rows of an index

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from` | Index directory to read (default: the index in use) |
| `--queue` | Queue the sources for re-ingestion by the daemon (only with --from pointing to an index no longer in use) |

| `acao` | setup downloads the model; status checks that it loads (one of: `setup`, `status`) |

## `delegation-core note`

Direct vault note access: write/read/update/list/find-similar


### `delegation-core note write`

Write a new note

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `folder` | Vault folder (see: delegation-core status) |
| `title` | note title (the body comes from stdin or --file) |
| `--file` | Read content from this file instead of stdin |
| `--local` | Do the work in this process instead of handing it to the running daemon |

### `delegation-core note read`

Print a note's full content

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `name` | Filename stem, partial match |

### `delegation-core note update`

Append content to an existing note

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `name` | Filename stem, partial match |
| `--file` | Read content from this file instead of stdin |
| `--local` | Do the work in this process instead of handing it to the running daemon |

### `delegation-core note list`

List notes in a folder, newest first

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `folder` | vault folder |
| `--limit` | notes to listDefault: `20`. |

### `delegation-core note find-similar`

Find notes semantically similar to a given note

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--local` | Do the work in this process instead of handing it to the running daemon |
| `name` | note name |
| `--threshold` | minimum similarityDefault: `0.8`. |
| `--limit` | notes to returnDefault: `5`. |

## `delegation-core ocr-setup`

Download OCR language data so images become searchable

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--langs` | comma list of tesseract languagesDefault: `"por,eng"`. |
| `--force` | download again even if present |

## `delegation-core policy`

Per-client tool policies: allow/block/require_approval/rate_limit


### `delegation-core policy show`

show the configured policies


### `delegation-core policy check`

which policy applies to a client and a tool

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `client` | client name |
| `tool` | tool name |

### `delegation-core policy set`

client ('*' for all), key (a tool or read/write/destructive), action

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `client` | client name, or '*' for all |
| `key` | a tool name, or read, write or destructive |
| `action` | allow, block, require_approval or rate_limit:N/S |

### `delegation-core policy unset`

remove a policy

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `client` | client name, or '*' for all |
| `key` | a tool name, or read, write or destructive |

## `delegation-core post-install`

Finish an install: docs, hooks, skills, dashboard, service, clients

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--root` | The source checkout; defaults to the recorded install source |
| `--no-wizard` | On a fresh install, report that setup is needed instead of running it |

## `delegation-core process`

Cross-session process tracking: create/list/update/get


### `delegation-core process create`

Start tracking a new process

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `name` | process name |
| `--description` | what the process is |
| `--steps` | Comma-separated step descriptions |

### `delegation-core process list`

List tracked processes

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--status` | active\|paused\|done\|cancelled\|allDefault: `"active"`. |
| `--query` | only processes whose name, description or notes contain this text |

### `delegation-core process update`

Update a tracked process

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `process_id` | process id |
| `--note` | note to append |
| `--step-done` | index of the step to mark done |
| `--status` | active, paused, done or cancelled |

### `delegation-core process get`

Full detail view of a tracked process

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `process_id` | process id |

## `delegation-core recover-index`

Move a damaged index aside; the daemon rebuilds it on its next start

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--index-path` | Rebuild the index at this path instead (e.g. out of a cloud-synced vault); saved as index_path in config.json |

## `delegation-core reindex`

Rebuild the search index from vault folders

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--force` | Reindex every note, not just those changed since last run (needed to backfill new metadata fields) |
| `--timeout` | Maximum seconds to wait for daemon job to complete (default 3600s, 0 for unlimited) |
| `--local` | Do the work in this process instead of handing it to the running daemon |

## `delegation-core relink`

Add wikilinks to notes in a vault subfolder

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--local` | Do the work in this process instead of handing it to the running daemon |
| `folder` | Vault-relative folder path (e.g. meetings) |
| `--days` | Restrict to notes modified within last N days |
| `--min-similarity` | Override similarity threshold (default from config) |
| `--max-links` | Maximum wikilinks per note (default 8)Default: `8`. |

## `delegation-core service`

Install/remove/stop/start the daemon as a per-user background service

|---|---|

## `delegation-core session`

Configure raw Claude Code and Codex transcript capture


### `delegation-core session status`

|---|---|

In manual mode, save the next completed client session

|---|---|

Throwaway daemon with its own HOME, vault and port

## `delegation-core update`

Update the installed package from its source, stopping the daemon first

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--channel` | branch: pull the current branch (default); stable: newest v* tag (one of: `branch`, `stable`) |
| `--rollback` | go back to the commit recorded before the last update |
| `--check` | Report what would change; touch nothing |
| `--no-restart` | Leave the daemon stopped after updating |

## `delegation-core update-finish`

Internal: second half of `update`, run by it in the newly installed code

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--root` | source checkout the update installed from |
